key_findings: Intrafemoral NCTC-2472 fibrosarcoma inoculation in C3H/HeN mice produces persistent spontaneous pain and mechanical hyperalgesia with osteolysis.

In BCP spinal dorsal horn, excitatory markers VGLUT1 and PSD95 increase while inhibitory markers VGAT and Gephyrin decrease, shifting E/I balance toward excitation with enlarged neuronal Ca2+ responses.
Reactive (GFAP+/C3+/S100a10+) SDH astrocytes engulf both excitatory and inhibitory synapses but preferentially GABAergic synapses.
Fluorocitrate inhibition of astrocytic activation is antinociceptive and partially restores synaptic remodeling.
Astrocytic (not neuronal) NRCAM is downregulated in BCP; AAV-mediated astrocytic NRCAM overexpression reduces GABAergic synapse engulfment and attenuates BCP.
